title.zh: FN 速递丨a16z 和 StarkWare 争吵密码学路线，Vitalik 想都交给 EIP-8288
title.en: FN 速递丨a16z 和 StarkWare 争吵密码学路线，Vitalik 想都交给 EIP-8288

current_state.zh: Vitalik Buterin has proposed an 'EIP-8288 maximization' approach that would shift Ethereum's cryptography strategy toward the standard and potentially stop adding new precompiles, amid debate with a16z and StarkWare over the best cryptographic roadmap.
